neighbours.label: The piece 'itz' (also 'itsu') right after a capital R in surnames/names like Ritz, Reitz
fire: Forget your dreams about The Ritz, because this little cafe serves coffee for three dollars.
The wedding dinner was held at the Ritz-Carlton, where the guests admired the marble lobby.
The old book was printed in Copenhagen by C. A. Reitz and sold across Scandinavia.
Not the Ritz, not a slum, was how the landlord described the small apartment downtown.
He booked a suite at the Ritz for the weekend after the long trip.
Our host, Herr Ritz, welcomed everyone and handed out maps of the old city.
A famous cracker brand shares its name with the Ritz hotel in London, many people say.
They stayed near the Ritz because the rooms there were quiet and the breakfast was generous.
